sec.title: August 27 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 222)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 27** across American and British radio, Michael Hordern and Richard Briers concluding P.G. Wodehouse's *The Mating Season* on *What Ho, Jeeves!*, two legendary frontier docudramas on *Death Valley Days* for 20 Mule Team Borax (1937 Snowshoe Thompson, 1942 Buck and Jess), Jack Smith and Dinah Shore on *The Tide Show* for Procter & Gamble, and Myrtle Vail's backstage serial *Myrt and Marge* (1937–1975):
